findings.title: mismatch_absent: v3 audit targets the canonical v6 runtime class and the process mutates state
findings.description: build_karr_chassis_v6 remaps karr_translation_v3 to runtime key karr_translation, so this re-audit is on the class that actually fires. The class is a Vivarium Process and next_update writes deltas to protein.unprocessed_counts and substrates. karr_translation_v3 imports opencell.m3.translation and opencell.m3.translation_v2; it does not import or wrap KarrTranslationProcess from karr_translation.py.
findings.suggested_canary: Assert build_karr_chassis_v6().processes['karr_translation'] is an instance of KarrTranslationV3Process and that one protein.unprocessed_counts key changes over 10 ticks.

findings.title: mismatch_confirmed: Translation still consumes shared substrates without allocator enrollment
findings.description: KarrTranslationV3Process writes negative substrate deltas directly into the shared substrates port. The v5/v6 allocation consumer list omits karr_translation_v3, and its topology has no requests/substrates_allocated ports. This remains a Track-A allocator-integrity bypass for Translation substrate traffic.
findings.suggested_canary: Fail when Translation writes substrates directly while karr_translation is absent from KarrAllocationStep consumer_processes.

findings.title: mismatch_confirmed: v3 remains a reduced mean-field model versus Karr's stochastic ribosome-state algorithm
findings.description: v3 predicts synthesis rates from a closed-form ribosome/mRNA expression and integrates proteins analytically each tick. The Karr process description specifies randomized initiation/elongation/termination and stalling/tmRNA transitions. v3 is therefore mechanistically closer than v1 but still not full Translation.m behavior.
findings.suggested_canary: Keep a strict differential test until fixture channels can validate stochastic-state transitions against MATLAB outputs.

findings.title: mismatch_confirmed: v3 substrate bookkeeping still covers only 20 amino acids
findings.fixture_evidence: Translation_flat.mat substrateWholeCellModelIDs has 26 channels (20 AA + FMET/GTP/GDP/PI/H2O/H), but v3 emits only 20 AA deltas
findings.description: v3 builds its substrates schema from the 20-AA vocabulary and emits deltas only for those amino acids. Karr Translation tracks extra metabolite channels including FMET and energy/water terms. This leaves a stoichiometric gap relative to the fixture/state space.
findings.suggested_canary: Assert that Translation substrate channels include FMET/GTP/GDP/PI/H2O/H or explicitly document why they are intentionally deferred.

findings.title: evidence_missing: Translation fixture remains non-replayable for one-tick MATLAB differential
findings.description: The replay loader still cannot classify any Translation input/output channel pairs for differential replay. Because fixture I/O channels are missing, the required Karr-vs-Python one-tick comparison cannot be numerically asserted and must stay strict xfail. This blocks a high-confidence D3 parity gate.
findings.suggested_canary: Add explicit Translation fixture before/after channel mappings and switch the replay test from strict xfail to numeric assert_replay_match.

findings.title: mismatch_absent: v3 Translation read/write ports have live producer-consumer partners
findings.description: Translation reads complex.counts.RIBOSOME_70S, which is initialized in chassis state and updated by complex processes sharing the same store. Its protein.unprocessed_counts output is consumed by downstream protein processing. The dominant integration defect remains allocator bypass, not a missing D4 endpoint.
findings.suggested_canary: Topology smoke-test that karr_translation exposes protein/substrates/complex and that protein_processing_i can read protein.unprocessed_counts.

findings.title: mismatch_confirmed: tick-0 monomer initialization still disagrees with Translation fixture
findings.fixture_evidence: Translation_flat.mat monomers(482) are all zero; v3 defaults have 296 non-zero proteins (sum=16177)
findings.description: The fixture tick-0 monomer vector is all zeros, but v3 seeds protein.unprocessed_counts from counts_mature by default and chassis initialization mirrors that non-zero profile. This reproduces the same non-trivial initialization mismatch observed in v1. Any replay comparison anchored at t=0 inherits this offset.
findings.suggested_canary: Explicitly compare fixture monomers at tick 0 against chassis protein.unprocessed_counts and fail when absolute mismatch exceeds tolerance.
